versions.name: Camp Sheppard

features.note: The lodge houses a dining hall and kitchen.
Ecology sessions in the winter camp program.
A range operates as part of the winter camp program.

versions.summary: Cascade forest resident camp bordering Mt. Rainier National Forest, offering hiking and ecology programs alongside a dining hall, shooting sports, climbing, COPE, and STEM activities.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website canonicalised 2026-07-25: https://seattlebsa.org/camp-sheppard/ now redirects to https://scoutingseattle.org/camp-sheppard/ (link audit, tools/check_urls.py). Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Unconfirmed codes inherited from camp-finder's frontend fixture data were removed 2026-07-27: camp-finder recorded these camps as fixture data for frontend development, not a live scrape, and no reachable source attests the removed codes. Generic amenities (dining hall, waterfront) are kept — this camp's page is a stub, so its silence about them is not evidence. Distinctive facilities a camp page would advertise are not.
